summary: The OAuth2 token-exchange call must use an http.Client carrying an explicit timeout (from the bound context deadline), not http.DefaultClient, matching every other outbound call in the CLI.
reason: exchangeClientCredentials used http.DefaultClient, which has no client-level Timeout. The context deadline still cancels the request, but the path diverged from newHTTPClient(timeout, nil) used everywhere else; derive client.Timeout from ctx.Deadline().
